includes: Explicit humid, dry or otherwise stated air-humidity state on the actual selected air/zone carrier, including a growing room or an outdoor air zone.
Preserve a stated humidity number, unit, relative/absolute qualifier and zone literally when supplied; do not invent a value, measurement, calibration, equilibrium or conversion.

Choose selected effect, independently required prerequisite or preservation from the whole source; room/air nouns do not determine mode. Keep actual source/binding guards and independently qualified owner/receiver locks.
excludes: Humid mood, tactile suggestion or a humidity variable name without an actual declared state/value/change.
Fog, steam, haze, visible airborne droplets or attenuation alone does not establish an air-humidity state; humidity alone does not require visible fog, droplets or lowered visibility.

Wet/damp/dry surfaces, sweat, condensation or a moisture-bearing material alone does not establish surrounding air humidity; explicit air humidity alone does not authorize surface wetness or condensation.
Temperature, weather, immersion, cultivation or a room label alone does not establish humidity. Do not infer a weather cause, humidifier, water source, chemical identity, thermal state or process.
Do not replace the actual air/zone carrier with every room surface, the whole world or an arbitrary foreground/main owner.
